title: Return rates
bodyMd: An online retailer lengthens its return window. The percentage of orders returned rises, while the number of repeat customers also rises. Management wants to know whether the policy improved profit. An analyst requests information on margins, return handling costs, and whether repeat purchases would have occurred without the change. Neither the return rate nor repeat-customer count alone settles the question.
